purpose: Five dated pre-draft first-round boards for the 2005 NBA Draft (researched, October 2026). Draft-night evidence for every club's board; never the real draft result. Each board is a published mock draft: rank_by_player is the slot the mock gave the player.
status: researched; every board's publication date sourced and before the draft's first selection (June 28, 2005, evening). Names normalized to Basketball-Reference spellings; the source spelling is noted where it differs.
same_sources_in_prospect_evidence: nba_2005_prospect_evidence.json carries these five mocks' slots under each prospect's pre_draft_rankings (same ids). A consumer averaging both files must count each source once.
withdrawn_players_on_boards: Rudy Fernández and Tiago Splitter appear on the CBS SportsLine board (May 27) but were not among the early-entry candidates remaining on draft night (nba_2005_prospect_evidence.json, withdrawn_before_draft); they cannot be selected.
gaps: No two-round 2005 mock or big board dated before the draft was reachable (NBADraft.net and DraftExpress 2005 mock pages return 404 or empty responses; ESPN Insider / Chad Ford and Dick Vitale's June 26, 2005 ESPN mock are behind a bot challenge; web.archive.org is unreachable). Second-round prospects therefore have no board slot.
A David Moore (Dallas Morning News, KRT) mock printed by the Ironton Tribune on June 29, 2005 was excluded: its publication date is after the draft even though it was written before it.
